sources.claim: A sole proprietorship is not a separate legal entity, so the owner can be held responsible for business debts; an LLC or corporation generally separates owners from business liability; the structure affects taxes and liability, and the SBA suggests talking with an attorney or accountant.

sections.skill: Matching the question to the expert

questions.prompt: A contract question goes to whom?
questions.correct_answer: An attorney
questions.intro: Think of health: you see a dentist for teeth and an eye doctor for eyes. Business questions work the same way. Legal questions (contracts, leases, disputes) go to an attorney. Money and tax questions go to an accountant or tax professional. Coverage questions go to an insurance agent. Asking the right expert saves time and gets a better answer.
